svg.text: R1 and R2 drawn to the same scale (dedicated-lane layouts, rotated 90 degrees)
R1: 8,809 NAND + 1,080 DFF, RAM as 128 gate tiles; board 4,581 x 29,698 cells (136.0 M)
R2: 2,034 NAND + 56 DFF, RAM part; board 4,222 x 6,318 cells (26.7 M)
One pixel = 20 x 20 cells. Orange: layer-0 copper; blue: layer-1 copper; parts are too small to see at this scale.
